parts.name: Motor Holder Body
parts.description: A single L-shaped bracket with a vertical mounting plate and a horizontal base. Includes a large central cutout for the motor and an angled support rib.

features.name: Vertical Mounting Plate
features.description: The tall vertical section of the L-shape.

features.name: Horizontal Base
features.description: The flat bottom section extending from the vertical plate.

features.name: Motor Cutout
features.description: Large irregular opening in the vertical plate to accommodate the motor body.

features.name: Motor Mounting Holes
features.description: Two circular holes for mounting the motor to the holder.

features.name: Support Rib
features.description: Triangular rib connecting the vertical plate to the base for structural support.

dimensions.size_provenance: measured ink spans x authoritative max dimension

uncertainties: Exact thickness of the vertical plate and base is inferred from the side view aspect ratio.
Exact diameter of motor mounting holes is estimated from relative size in the top view.
generation_notes: The object is interpreted as a standard 3D-printed motor mount. The front view defines the L-profile. The top view shows the footprint and the motor cutout. The right view confirms the thickness and the angled rib.

parameters.description: Large irregular opening in the vertical plate to accommodate the motor body.

multi_view_contract: All source views constrain one shared physical object; never instantiate views as separate geometry.
cutout_policy: Closed internal profiles are subtractive through-cutouts unless explicitly classified otherwise.
